verdict.rationale: Codex Plugins is a plugin platform built on MCP. Plugins use the Model Context Protocol to expose server-backed capabilities, can contain MCP servers or be remote MCP-only, and installed plugins add MCP tools to Codex and ChatGPT sessions. The plugin-creator skill also wires MCP servers into new plugins. However, the evidence only shows MCP servers consumed inside OpenAI's own agents through plugin packaging, not an official MCP server endpoint that an arbitrary external agent can connect to. Missing for 10: a documented official MCP server endpoint or connection instructions for third-party agents, independent hands-on corroboration of MCP connectivity.
